source.description:
PROBLEM
The board shows unitAI-rrdnt.21 (workspace writer lease) and unitAI-rrdnt.31 (uncertain workspace reconciliation) both closed and green. A reasonable reader concludes that leasing and reconciliation are in force. Neither is. Verified on the merged tree at 696d3f49: acquire(), release() and admitToolCall() have zero callers in src/; reconcile() has zero callers in src/. Both are harmless only because write-capable activations are refused at admission in src/activation/native-host.ts:199 (writer_not_supported_in_phase_1). A closed bead is the strongest signal this project emits, and two of them currently say something false by implication.

One correction to the framing this bead was requested under, because it changes what the statement must say. workspace-reconcile.ts IS imported by src/tools/specialist/specialist_status.tool.ts, so the READ path is live: projectUncertainWorkspaces() runs on every specialist_status call and would report a genuinely uncertain workspace today. What is unwired is the ENFORCEMENT path — nothing acquires a lease, nothing checks one before a mutation, and nothing calls reconcile(). The statement must distinguish these, or it will read as false to anyone who greps and finds the import.

SUCCESS
A reader arriving at the epic learns, without reading code, that lease enforcement and reconciliation exist, are tested, and are called by nothing; that this is currently safe because writers are refused at admission; and which bead changes it.

SCRUTINY
MEDIUM

Rationale: this is an audit of whether closed enforcement beads are actually in force, so its output is a set of claims about guarantees the system does or does not make. Getting it wrong in the optimistic direction reports a guarantee that is not enforced, which is worse than reporting nothing. It changes no runtime behaviour itself, which is why this is MEDIUM rather than HIGH.

SCOPE
The unitAI-rrdnt epic description, which is the surface people actually read, and docs/design/native-activation-reconciliation.md as the second surface. The statement names: what exists (workspace-lease.ts, workspace-reconcile.ts), what calls it (nothing on the enforcement path; specialist_status calls the read-only projection), why that is currently safe (native-host.ts:199 refuses write-capable activations), and the bead that changes it (unitAI-rrdnt.36, Phase 10).

Add the pattern, not just the incident. Three modules in this epic have reached complete, tested, closed and called by nothing: the workspace lease, reconciliation, and per the coordinator the interaction transport, which had no deliver hook wired and so could not carry a question to a coordinator until it was found. All three passed their own suites. The method that caught every one was grepping for the import, not reading the code. A lane that internalises green does not mean reachable will find the fourth faster than any process will.

NON_GOALS
Does not wire anything. Does not reopen .21 or .31 — both are correctly closed for what they contracted to deliver. Does not add a lint rule, a CI check, or an unused-export detector; if that is wanted it is a separate bead with its own false-positive budget. Does not edit the closed beads' notes.

CONSTRAINTS
The statement must be accurate at the granularity above: enforcement unwired, read projection live. A statement that says reconciliation is entirely uncalled is falsifiable by one grep and will be dismissed along with the warning it carries.
Cite native-host.ts:199 by symbol (writer_not_supported_in_phase_1) as well as line, because the line will move.

VALIDATION
1. The epic description carries the statement; bd show unitAI-rrdnt displays it without opening a file.
2. docs/design/native-activation-reconciliation.md carries the same statement.
3. Each claim in the statement is re-verified against the tree at the time of writing, not copied from this bead: grep for callers of acquire, release, admitToolCall and reconcile in src/, and confirm the admission refusal is still present.
4. unitAI-rrdnt.36 gains a VALIDATION line requiring this statement to be retired when Phase 10 lands, so the warning does not outlive the gap. Same rule the docs lane applied to the .38 holes-table row.

OUTPUT
The enforcement-status statement on both surfaces, and the retirement requirement recorded on unitAI-rrdnt.36.
source.title: State enforcement status on the epic: closed lease and reconciliation beads are not in force
